name: Emirates Global Investments
description: Investing in your future, on and off the track.
story: Emirates Global Investments (EGI) is a leading UAE-based investment firm dedicated to fostering innovation and growth across various sectors. Recognizing the global appeal and technological advancements within motorsport, EGI seeks partnerships that reflect their commitment to excellence and cutting-edge performance. They view motorsport as a valuable platform to showcase their brand and build relationships with a discerning global audience, while supporting rising talent and pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
